expectedText: I would like my community to organize a cleanup beside a river. The place is a habitat for wildlife, and litter can harm animals that live there. First, the path is checked by a local guide. Then rubbish is collected by volunteers wearing gloves. Clean metal cans and accepted plastic bottles are put into separate boxes for recycling. We can also reduce waste by bringing our own water bottles. After the cleanup, the group could reuse old wood to make signs asking visitors to keep the path clean. This action will not solve all pollution, but it may help people care for the environment. I hope children and adults can work together and continue the habit.
